description: NARIT-AI will integrate legal provisions, case laws, and investigative procedures to provide real-time analytical support to law enforcement agencies in handling complex narcotics cases.
body_lead: Data tabled in Lok Sabha last year showed that an average of a third of drug-related cases in Gujarat have seen convictions since 2020. Now, the Gujarat Police has developed an artificial intelligence (AI)-based tool to help police make tighter cases under the Narcotics Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act to ensure conviction. Earlier this month, the Gujarat government announced the Narcotics Analysis & RAG-based Investigation Tool (NARIT-AI).
